method: Hash and index destination validation; two decoded final-master samples inside every scheduled native-motion segment; left game-pane pixel change. Human-visible sample inspection is recorded separately; metadata is not treated as proof of teaching sufficiency.
thresholdNote: Under five seconds is a diagnostic flag, not an automatic pedagogical fail/pass. Still frames and self-authored models are excluded from native gameplay duration.
